ownerDirective.speaker: Governor
ownerDirective.exactText: i'm the governmor of the minecraft world and I've come to cut red tape
ownerDirective.interpretation: The Governor delegates this finite Ravensreach controlled-discharge work to the implementation team while retaining the complete hard-safety kernel.

mvpBoundary.included: Only the exact sealed RR-SE-1 ladder and transfer to the existing RR-SE-2 shaft.
mvpBoundary.exclusionRule: It never authorizes public access, rail, vehicle, platform, power, signal, or passenger service.

hardSafetyKernel.rule: Exact source/target states, package inversion, and independent QA are required.
Capture a fresh complete immutable source and exact preflight immediately before mutation.
Forward and rollback parser checks are strict-noop.
Exact block and fresh live entity clearance is mandatory.
Execution is journaled and any failure invokes reverse-order exact rollback.
Fresh post capture, rollback poststate proof, and independent QA precede acceptance.

operationalControls.scopeLocalFailureRule: Failure is contained to this exact release.
